caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane in the shape of a rooster mounted on top of a vertical pole. The rooster has a prominent, rounded tail with layered feather details and a comb on its head formed by triangular points. Below the rooster, there are four horizontal arms arranged in a cross shape, each ending in one of the cardinal direction letters: "N", "E", "S", and "W". The right side shows the letters "E" and "N" while the left shows "S" and "W". The rooster and the directional letters are drawn in gray pencil with soft shading to suggest three-dimensional form, casting slight shadows. The background is a plain, lightly textured off-white or beige surface, and the entire composition is centered vertically with the objects occupying the upper middle portion of the page.
title: Weather Vane
